ruleDefinitions.name: Creation of WerFault.exe/Wer.dll in Unusual Folder
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of a file named "WerFault.exe" or "wer.dll" in an uncommon folder, which could be a sign of WerFault DLL hijacking.

sequences.query: (file_path = RGX("\\\\WerFault\\\.exe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\\wer\\\.dll$")) AND  NOT ((file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SoftwareDistribution\\\\") OR file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\") OR file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\") OR file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\")))
